# Existing product audit and improvement — stages

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

Audit an existing product across product fit, UX, technical quality and security, consolidate findings into a prioritised improvement roadmap with evidence, and feed the maintenance cycle of monitoring, incident learning and dependency hygiene.

**Trigger:** An existing application needs assessment, improvement planning or ongoing maintenance.
